task.title: Add curated Roleplay workflow profiles
task.classification: persistent chat configuration, runtime provider selection, and cross-entrypoint Roleplay UX

coreClaim: Roleplay users can inspect, selectively apply, and conflict-safely revert one of four versioned workflow profiles without silently changing chat identity, TTS, writer routing, paid media, or unrelated settings.

inScope: Four versioned Roleplay profile recipes and inspectable change ledgers
Selected-item-only patch construction and conflict-safe receipt-based revert
Per-chat agent connection and cadence override precedence
Chat-preset round trips for override maps while excluding application receipts
Roleplay setup-wizard, Chat Settings, focused-settings, and Discover entrypoints
Embedded and hostable-runtime use of the existing typed chat update API
outOfScope: Silently enabling optional Illustrator or Music Player rows
Adding Rust commands, HTTP routes, schema migrations, or new providers
Deploying or changing live Raspberry Pi data

claimBoundary.coreClaim: The chooser discloses and applies only selected valid profile items in one chat update, records only configuration before/after values, and reverts matching applied values without overwriting later edits.
claimBoundary.riskType: persistent chat configuration, provider routing, legacy/default compatibility, cross-entrypoint behavior, and external data disclosure
entrypoints: Final optional step of standard new-Roleplay setup
Roleplay-only Workflow profile control in Chat Settings
Automatic agent connection and cadence resolution during generation
currentPathsOrFormats: Optional ChatMetadata agentConnectionOverrides, agentRunIntervalOverrides, and roleplayWorkflowApplication fields
Existing typed storageApi.update chats path shared by embedded and remote runtimes
Existing Universal V2 preset owner and built-in agent identifiers
legacyPathsOrFormats: Chats without the new optional override or receipt fields keep the pre-existing runtime fallbacks
Older presets omit override maps and therefore clear profile-specific maps through normal preset defaults
Existing custom prompt, memory, agent, connection, cadence, identity, lorebook, sprite, summary, and scene values remain unchanged unless their disclosed rows are selected
outOfScopeClaims: Profiles do not guarantee a provider's price or latency.
Profiles do not install models, create provider credentials, or purchase media calls.
Profiles do not make multiple independent chat writes atomic across chats.
Profiles do not roll back later user edits that conflict with the recorded applied value.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: The shipped Roleplay capabilities previously had no single inspectable opt-in composition path, while agent routing and cadence had no per-chat profile override layer.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: React-free Roleplay recipes produce disclosed diffs; the catalog owner persists one selected valid patch; runtime generation consumes optional per-chat overrides without changing missing-field behavior.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Pure recipe resolution and patch/revert builders own configuration meaning, catalog hooks re-read and perform one typed chat update, and agent-runner applies explicit precedence with fail-closed dangling overrides.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src/engine owns profile and runtime semantics; src/features owns chooser capabilities, persistence orchestration, and entrypoint UI.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not duplicate recipe or runtime interpretation in Roleplay React surfaces, add raw remote requests, or add a Rust migration for optional metadata fields.

positiveRows.claim: All four v1 recipes expose the exact required agents, cadence, destinations, prerequisites, and default selections.
positiveRows.evidence: workflow-profiles.spec.ts covers the exact recipe definitions, call estimates, missing prerequisites, optional media rows, explicit-value defaults, selected-item-only patches, and Local Assist tracker-only routing.

positiveRows.claim: Application is atomic and stale previews cannot write an outdated selection.
positiveRows.evidence: use-chat-presets.spec.ts proves latest-chat re-read, stale rejection with zero updates, one update for valid application, receipt replacement, and total failure with no partial write.

positiveRows.claim: Revert restores only fields still equal to their recorded applied values.
positiveRows.evidence: Pure revert-builder and catalog-hook tests prove matching fields restore prior values, later edits become reported conflicts, unrelated values remain untouched, and the active receipt clears.

positiveRows.claim: The visible chooser is available from both Roleplay entrypoints and Discover with inspectable cost, destination, prerequisite, and settings-link copy.
positiveRows.evidence: Chooser, drawer-control, entrypoint, overlay, and discovery suites pass; a local browser session verified desktop and 390px phone layouts in dark and light themes and completed apply/revert through a mocked remote /api/invoke path.

contradictionRows.claim: Local Assist must not fall through to a paid or external provider when a selected local assignment becomes invalid.
contradictionRows.evidence: Agent-runner and apply-hook tests prove dangling explicit overrides fail per agent, invalid local assignments are omitted and reported, existing active routes are preserved, and no substitute connection is selected.

contradictionRows.claim: Optional Illustrator, Music Player, and TTS behavior must not become automatic profile mutations.
contradictionRows.evidence: Resolver and component tests prove Illustrator and Music Player start unchecked, unusable prerequisites disable their rows, destination copy names external use, and TTS is informational with an ordinary-settings link only.

contradictionRows.claim: Profile persistence must not copy chat identity or rollback history into presets.
contradictionRows.evidence: Preset tests prove override maps round-trip while receipts, character/persona/lorebook/summary/sprite/scene-owned identity fields remain excluded.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Missing per-chat connection and cadence overrides retain existing behavior.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: agent-runner.test.ts proves stored agent configuration, default agent connection, writer connection, stored cadence, and built-in cadence fallbacks remain in their previous order when maps are absent.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing explicit chat values remain opt-in rather than silently overwritten.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Resolver regressions cover custom prompts, disabled Memory Recall, existing agents, explicit enableAgents true with an empty list, existing routes, and existing cadence values defaulting unchecked.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Older presets clear profile-specific maps without copying a prior application receipt.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: Preset hook tests cover older/default preset application and ordinary preset precedence.

untestedRows: The exact wide new-chat wizard entrypoint was component- and structure-tested but was not opened in the local remote-runtime browser harness.
No real Pi or paid external provider was invoked; remote equivalence used the typed runtime seam and a mocked /api/invoke browser path.

ownedFacts.description: The resolver defines four profile IDs at recipe version 1 and exports the existing Universal V2 identifier from its Roleplay owner.
ownedFacts.evidence: Direct source inspection plus exact recipe assertions in workflow-profiles.spec.ts.

ownedFacts.description: The final focused verification covers 104 tests across ten files.
ownedFacts.evidence: Final pnpm vitest run reported 10 passed files and 104 passed tests after the runtime-gate, Local Assist pairing, and reordered-capability-request regressions.

ownedFacts.description: The final tree passes the full TypeScript, architecture, discovery, production-build, Rust, deterministic-repository, and diff checks.
ownedFacts.evidence: pnpm typecheck, pnpm check:architecture, pnpm check:discovery, pnpm build, pnpm check, and git diff --check all exited successfully.

userActionCopy.description: No backup is required for ordinary use because every change is previewed and the receipt supports conflict-safe revert. A user who wants an independent copy before changing chat settings can export a full backup.
userActionCopy.source: De-Koi Settings > Backups for the current profile
userActionCopy.destination: A user-selected folder outside De-Koi's application data directory
files: The downloaded De-Koi backup archive containing chats and companion profile records
userActionCopy.action: Create and download the backup archive before applying the profile, then confirm the archive exists in the selected folder.
detectedLayouts: Existing embedded or remote profile data remains in place and is not deleted by apply or revert

manualBlockers.item: Exact wide new-chat wizard live-browser entrypoint
manualBlockers.reason: The final step mount and responsive width are covered by focused component/entrypoint tests and source inspection; actual browser layout was verified through the same chooser in desktop drawer and phone views.
The feature reuses the existing typed update/runtime boundaries and tests both missing-field and remote-capable paths without spending money or mutating live user data.

verification.baselineEvidence: Ten focused files passed 104 tests; pnpm typecheck, pnpm check:architecture, pnpm check:discovery, pnpm build, pnpm check, and git diff --check passed on the final uncommitted tree.

notes: The user authorized commit, push, PR, hosted checks, and merge in the current turn.
The isolated worktree was created from origin/main and the dirty primary checkout remains untouched.
